references.text: Nicodemus came to Jesus at night out of fear of the Jews, just as Gideon acted at night because he feared his father's house and the men of the city.
Joseph of Arimathea was a secret disciple out of fear of the Jews, similar to Gideon's fear that led him to act secretly at night.
The Israelites did as the Lord had commanded, in the same way that Gideon did what the Lord said to him.
Saul admitted that he feared the people and listened to their voice, similar to Gideon's fear of the men of the city.
Abraham took two servants with him to carry out what God had commanded him, just as Gideon took ten of his servants to do what the Lord said.
The preceding context where the Lord commands Gideon to tear down the altar of Baal, which Gideon obeys in verse 27.
